about: Every word the presenter adds beside the pre-registered sentences once the final run is published: the report's lede and card, its section leads, the final charts' titles, headings, descriptions and captions, the history page's names for the final run's files, the report page's tiles, lede, description and footer. A template holds no number of its own and no model id: each placeholder is filled from presentation.json, and a template declares its placeholders in its fields.

report.lede.text: > Generated by `python -m evals.present` from `evals/results` (the headline: `{source}`, the pre-registered final run). Do not edit by hand: change `evals/present/` and run `python -m evals.present --write`. The same report as a page: [{pages}]({pages}).

limitations.synthetic.text: The letters are synthetic, one or two clean pages each: real post is messier.

limitations.pooled.text: The earlier held-out splits were recorded with the code and prompts of their day, and their statistics chosen after their results were known: **not pre-registered**. The final run's were pre-registered before any recording ([Provenance]({anchor})).

limitations.reads.text: Reads of each letter in the final run: {reads} of the {registered} pre-registered, recorded within days, so they measure run-to-run noise, not drift over months.

limitations.reads.one.text: Reads of each letter in the final run: {reads} of the {registered} pre-registered, so no run-to-run noise was measured.

limitations.labels.text: The labels are code, audited by agents of the same model family; no lawyer reviewed the rules.

limitations.kinds.text: The letter families leave out most of the rarer high-stakes kinds the engine covers; the final run's new kinds are a small set ([Results]({anchor})).

limitations.land.text: The benchmark gives Ordnung the Land on the letterhead; the app counts without it until the person sets or confirms it ([Results]({anchor})).

limitations.ask.text: Ask's held-out set holds out only its questions ([Results]({anchor})); the Ask numbers outside the final run's sentences are its development set's, not held out.
